phoneGate.title: Add your phone number
phoneGate.sub: The phone is your account's second contact: it recovers access and receives notifications. The studio number does not fit here — this one has to be yours.

validation.phoneTaken: This phone number is already taken
validation.emailInStudio: This person already works at your studio
validation.phoneInStudio: This person already works at your studio
validation.accountWillBeLinked: An account with this contact already exists — they will be linked to your studio

errors.invalid_bot_token: Telegram rejected this token — make sure the bot exists
errors.wa_payment_required: No payment method. Without a card on WhatsApp Business, Meta won't deliver a single notification — open the WhatsApp channel settings and add payment
errors.wa_verification_required: Your business hasn't passed Meta's verification. Until it does, the number stays rate-limited and nothing goes out — open the WhatsApp channel settings for the walkthrough
errors.wa_templates_pending: Templates aren't approved by Meta yet. Without an approved template you can't message a client first — wait for the review to finish, the status is in the WhatsApp channel settings

checkout.package_inactive: Package is no longer for sale
checkout.card_unavailable: Card payment is not available yet
checkout.promo_expired: Promo code is no longer valid
checkout.balance_changed: The points or deposit were already spent elsewhere — recalculate the payment
checkout.attempt_in_progress: A payment for this sale is already in progress — wait for the result or refresh

billing.tax_details_required: Add the studio country in the invoice details — the invoice can't be issued without it
billing.nothing_to_pay: Nothing left to pay on the current subscription
billing.stripe_not_configured: Payments are not configured on the server
billing.stripe_error: The payment service rejected the request. Please try again
billing.plan_not_paid: A higher plan is activated by payment only
billing.vat_invalid: VIES doesn't recognise this VAT number — check it or save without one
billing.vat_unavailable: The VIES registry isn't responding right now — try again later or save without a number
billing.vat_country_mismatch: The VAT number must start with the selected country's code
billing.commission_unsettled: Settle the offline-sales commission first: press "Pay now" in the commission block. Once that invoice is paid you can move to a fixed plan.
billing.billing_profile_required: Add your billing details — the commission invoice is issued to them.
billing.combo_switch_requires_payment: Moving from the fixed + percent plan to a fixed one is a purchase: press "Pay", pick a fixed plan and pay for the period.

loyalty.cert_used: Certificate has already been redeemed or is invalid

notifications.critical_locked: This notification cannot be turned off
notifications.last_channel: At least one delivery channel is required
notifications.not_personal: Personal settings can't change required notifications

errors.trial_already_used: The free trial is no longer available for this studio.
